exposure: Confirmed infection within 30 days before or at delivery
Women negative for SARS-CoV-2 infection or without any test results
Confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection from conception through 31 days before delivery
cohort: Pregnant women in Georgia who had completed 22 weeks of gestation and delivered between February 28, 2020, and August 31, 2022
finding: Pregnant women in Georgia with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection within 30 days before or at delivery experienced a considerably higher risk of maternal death and post-delivery ICU admission, and a slightly higher risk for CS delivery.
mod_finding: Pregnant women in Georgia with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection within 30 days before or at delivery had a slightly higher risk for CS delivery.
